The Lion Restaurant

Our Story

The Story

Our restaurant specialises in both Japanese and Sri Lankan cuisine. It is a fusion of flavours from our life. The array of enchanting spices from the roots of Sri Lanka intertwined with the delicate art of Japanese cuisine, all available on our menu. From me and my wife’s time in Japan and our mother country’s cuisine. My brother-in-law and I began our journey of opening this restaurant during the pandemic, facing lots of hardships and delays due to restrictions. Of course now I can see that I do not regret the journey we have taken as a family to be able to create a community here at The Lion, where we offer exceptional customer service and even better food. Now, when I see what this restaurant has become, I see a place where people can come together and create memories and the idea that my food can help them do that… That is what reminds me why this business was started.

View More

Best Quality Foods

Services

fresh Foods

Delve into a sensory feast at Lion Restaurant, where the authentic flavors of Sri Lanka and Japan are brought to life. Our culinary creations are an explosion of bold tastes, vibrant colors, and captivating aromas. We celebrate the rich heritage of Sri Lankan and Japanese cuisines by using a symphony of spices, herbs, and the freshest ingredients. Our menu is a kaleidoscope of sweet, sour, spicy, and savory dishes, enriched with traditional spices like cinnamon, cardamom, and cloves, as well as fresh herbs such as curry leaves and pandan. We offer a wide array of vegetarian and non-vegetarian options, each known for its bold flavor profile and rich, satisfying texture. Whether you’re a seasoned aficionado or exploring these cuisines for the first time, Lion Restaurant promises a delightful culinary journey with every dish.

Your attendant is important for us, RESERVE NOW.

Reserve

Reserve A Table

Our team is eager to assist you with reservations, queries, or any specific requests. Lion Restaurant is the perfect spot for diverse taste preferences, combining Sri Lankan warmth and Japanese precision in every dish.
